about_the_game:
Ambrosia Sky is a first-person action game about cleaning up after a deadly, sentient contamination. Take on the role of Dalia as she returns to her home in the outer rings of Saturn to investigate strange deaths and the alien contamination that caused them. 

 

Ambrosia Sky’s unique gameplay blends FPS action with meditative cleaning. Use a chemical sprayer to clean fungal contamination, harvest its fruit, and upgrade your gear to survive the crisis. 


Each species of alien fungus blurs the line between environment and enemies with their unique behaviors such as fiery explosions, electricity, or actively seeking Dalia out. 

Craft new ammo types that mimic the gameplay abilities of the fungus, upgrade your sprayer for more efficiency, and upgrade your tether to navigate and explore the unstable gravity of the Cluster. 

As you explore, you’ll encounter victims of the crisis and lay them to rest. These scenes reveal the mystery of the crisis and connect the disaster to the lives of the people who fell victim to it.

Use a tether device to grab objects, uncover hidden corners of the world, and explore environments with unstable gravity that can change direction and strength at any time. 

IN THIS DEMO

Encounter strange fungus, lay victims to rest, and upgrade your gear in this demo, which includes:

  • Explore two levels from the full game

  • Harvest Explosive fungus to craft fire spray

  • Harvest Electrical fungus to craft conductive spray

  • Complete the first Death Ritual of the game

  • Includes a sample of upgrades from the full progression system

ABOUT THE DEVELOPMENT TEAM

Soft Rains is a game studio focused on bringing world-class development experience to our work, from worldbuilding and memorable storytelling to immersive gameplay and art.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.6.24 or higher
  • Processor: Steam Deck APU or other Quad-core processor, 2.4 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Steam Deck APU, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or other equivalent with 8 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.6.24 or higher
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2080 or equivalent with 8 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: You are Dalia, a deep-space disaster specialist dispatched to the rings of Saturn. You’ll lay victims to rest, clean up alien fungus, and research its strange origins. Adapt to survive, cleanse the contamination, and escape the crisis.
